Privacy

Privacy

The site has no visitor accounts and shows no advertising. This page explains what happens to the information you send us.

Your contact and partnership enquiries

When you send a form, the school records your name, organisation, email or phone number, the type of support, the project concerned and your message. This information is used only to reply to you and follow up on your proposal. It is stored on the site’s server, can be read by school leadership and the people in charge of partnerships, and is notified to the school by email. It is neither sold nor shared. It is kept for three years after our last exchange, then deleted. Your IP address is used only for ten minutes, in a non-readable form, to limit abusive submissions.

Your rights

You can ask to see, correct or delete the information about you, or object to its use, by writing to the school through the Contact page. You can also contact Burkina Faso’s data protection authority, the Commission de l’Informatique et des Libertés (CIL).

Version dated 21 October 2026.
